issues.title: [Outcome] Resolve Faster: outcome agreement (DRAFT)
issues.body:
> **Fictional demo record.** Lumen Ridge Outfitters, its people, and all numbers are synthetic.

**Status: DRAFT (proposed, not agreed).** Awaiting acceptance by Dana Whitfield (sponsor).

| Field | Draft |
|---|---|
| Beneficiary and desired change | Lumen Ridge customers with a support ticket get it resolved faster, without lower quality |
| Strategic purpose / why now | Retention through the holiday returns season; slow resolution is the top CSAT complaint driver |
| Outputs → adoption → outcome → value | KB articles, AI triage, order data in tickets → agents and customers use them → lower median resolution time with guardrails held → retention |
| Measure | Median hours from ticket created to final resolved, all channels, monthly (HelixDesk) |
| Baseline | 38 h, Q2 2026 HelixDesk export (2026-04-01 to 06-30) |
| Target and window | 24 h by 2027-03-31 (monthly median, March 2027) |
| Outcome owner | Dana Whitfield (PROPOSED: not yet confirmed in writing) |
| Guardrails | CSAT ≥ 4.3/5 (baseline 4.4, Q2 2026); reopen rate ≤ 8% |
| Reopen baseline | **BASELINE GAP**: tracking began 2026-08-01; Aug–Sep 2026 observed 7.1%. Proposed step: reconstruct Q2 2026 from the HelixDesk event log, or agree Aug–Oct 2026 as the reference period |
| Exclusions | Ridgebot 2.0 (separate initiative) |
| Priority rule | Guardrails beat speed: a speed gain that breaches a guardrail does not count |
| Constraints | Holiday change freeze 2026-11-20 to 2027-01-08; Data Platform capacity (3 FTE) |

**Open questions**
1. Is the reopen guardrail measured against a reconstructed Q2 baseline or Aug–Oct 2026?
2. Does the target hold if RF-3 misses the freeze?
3. Who confirms outcome ownership: Dana Whitfield alone, or with the CFO?

issues.title: [Experiment] E-07 Suggested macros (results appended)
issues.body:
> **Fictional demo record.** Lumen Ridge Outfitters, its people, and all numbers are synthetic.

**Approved 2026-09-04 by Dana Whitfield. Original card (unchanged):**

- Hypothesis: If HelixDesk suggests a ranked macro for each ticket in the pilot queue, median resolution falls to ≤ 30 h because agents spend less time composing replies.
- Pilot: General Orders B, 20 agents. Comparison: General Orders A, 20 agents. 2026-09-08 to 2026-10-03.
- Guardrails: reopen ≤ 8%; CSAT ≥ 4.3.
- Continue if median ≤ 30 h with guardrails held. Pivot if ≥ 2 h better than comparison but > 30 h, guardrails held. Stop if reopen > 8% or CSAT < 4.3 for two consecutive weeks. Inconclusive if < 3,000 tickets or mix shift > 10 points.
- Pause authority: **not named**.

---
**Results (appended 2026-10-09):**

| Measure | Pilot before | Pilot during | Comparison before | Comparison during |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Median resolution | 37 h | 33 h | 37 h | 36 h |
| Reopen rate | 7.0% (273/3,900) | 9.2% (368/4,000) | 7.1% (284/4,000) | 7.3% (292/4,000) |
| CSAT | 4.4 | 4.3 | 4.4 | 4.4 |

Weekly pilot reopen: 8.1%, 9.0%, 9.8%, 9.9%. Stop criterion met at end of week 2 (2026-09-19); test ran to 2026-10-03. Macros rolled back 2026-10-03.

issues.title: [Benefits] RF-2 AI triage pilot: benefits review request
issues.body:

issues.title: [Benefits] RF-1 Knowledge base: outcome effect unmeasured
issues.body:
> **Fictional demo record.** Lumen Ridge Outfitters, its people, and all numbers are synthetic.

**Output:** 180 articles rewritten (complete 2026-09-30). **Adoption:** article views +45% (41,000 → 59,450/month).
**Outcome evidence:** none. No measure links views to deflected tickets or faster resolution.

Proposed measure (to agree): monthly ticket volume per 1,000 orders for topics covered by refreshed articles, and median resolution for tickets where the agent linked a refreshed article. Owner: Jordan Avery (PROPOSED).
